meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你写的驱动脚本在后台(pty)无头运行引擎应用,捕捉每一帧画面、叠加你的操作标记,录制成视频,并生成含视频、时间线和各项检查结果的摘要页面。
howto.when: 当你要求验证引擎应用(如渲染、交互行为),或需要录制应用运行过程并输出带检查项的验证摘要时触发。

say.text: 帮我写个驱动脚本,验证输入 hello 后画面更新。
say.note: Claude 会生成脚本、运行并录制,最后打开摘要页。

say.text: 驱动引擎应用,在指定像素坐标点击并检查画面是否重绘。
say.note: 会触发点击和 rec.check 断言。

say.text: 运行验证并打开 summary.html 摘要页面。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs the engine app headlessly in a pty, captures every emitted frame, overlays your inputs (click ripples, caption bar), encodes a video, and generates a summary page containing the video, timeline, and check results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to verify an engine app (e.g., rendering or interaction behavior) or need to record an app run and output a verification summary with checks.

say_en.text: Write a driver script to verify that typing 'hello' updates the screen.
say_en.note: Claude generates the script, runs it, records video, and opens the summary.

say_en.text: Drive the engine app, click at pixel (600,200), and check if the frame changes.
say_en.note: Triggers a click and a rec.check assertion.

say_en.text: Run the verification and open the summary.html page.
say_en.note: Finishes recording and opens the deliverable.
